articles.title: Australia, Japan seal warship deal with 3 Mogami frigates ordered first
articles.summary: Australia and Japan have signed a A$10 billion contract for the first three Japanese-designed warships, with the initial delivery expected in three years. This significant defence deal highlights growing strategic cooperation between the two Indo-Pacific nations, strengthening their naval capabilities and regional security alliances. It signifies a major step in bolstering their maritime presence.

articles.title: IAF clears Pune runway for flights after frontline jet incident
articles.summary: The Pune airport runway was reopened by Saturday morning, the Indian Air Force confirmed. This occurred a day after a frontline aircraft's hard-landing damaged the strip, halting flight operations. The swift restoration ensured minimal disruption to air travel, highlighting efficient response and repair capabilities by defence authorities, crucial for maintaining operational readiness.
